scope: Synthetic Model ObjectStroke source getters -> Drawing-selected GLV1 -> RTV1 vector. No SDK deserialization, GLV2, or paint output. Expected XYZ words are native assertion outputs.

encoding.source_point_and_pressure_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; interpret as IEEE-754 f32 bits
encoding.native_xyz_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; native vector bytes decoded little-endian into f32 words
encoding.size_word: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; decoded from source getter byte encoding

provenance.capture_source: Hash-pinned MagicPen saved-caller runner, parameterized by this script; wrapper SHA-256 uses a stable <FIXTURE_OUTPUT> placeholder for the temporary output path. Each case records its adapted wrapper digest and actual getter/output capture.
